title: Massachusetts controlled-prescription retention
rule_summary: A pharmacy keeps controlled-substance prescriptions for two years and makes them available for inspection under Massachusetts law.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply prescription records requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.
exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing prescription records with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
